title: HathiTrust Volume Record
description: Schema for a single HathiTrust volume record in the corpus-nz-hathi manifest. Compatible with shared-nz-corpus-core schema. Includes HF multi-config subset routing.

$schema.description: URI of the JSON Schema that this record conforms to (self-identifying)

htid.description: HathiTrust volume ID (e.g. uc1.b2889853) -- primary identifier

category.description: Content category for the volume — used for HF config/subset routing

subset.description: Hugging Face dataset config/subset name for this volume. Maps to a HF multi-config key, e.g. debates, debates-1890s, supplementary-indexes.

year.description: Publication year (extracted from imprint or title). Null when indeterminate.

volume.description: Volume number or identifier string (from enumcron)

title.description: Full bibliographic title of the volume

collection_id.description: HathiTrust collection ID (e.g. 71329709 for NZ Parliamentary Debates)

source.description: Source institution code (e.g. uc1 for University of California)

lccn.description: Library of Congress Control Number if available

sha256.description: SHA-256 checksum of the volume content file

size_bytes.description: File size in bytes of the volume content

pipeline_version.description: Pipeline version that produced this record

record_schema_version.description: Version of the volume record schema
